description: This Java class 'YAxisData' manages mapping and storage of Y-values (and their associated data) for a fixed X coordinate, likely used for representing or processing sensor or calibration data points in a larger system. It supports adding values, retrieving interpolated or specific Y-data, and exporting data to a writer, among other functionalities.

classes.name: YAxisData
classes.description: Represents a set of Y-values mapped to a fixed X, with methods for data manipulation and export.

classes.name: ValuesHolder
classes.description: Inner class that stores aggregate data (total and count) for Y-values, providing methods to retrieve average, add new values, or set a specific value.

methods.name: YAxisData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the YAxisData with a specific X value.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the X coordinate associated with this YAxisData object.

methods.name: getYs
methods.description: Provides a navigable set of Y-values stored in the map.

methods.name: findZ
methods.description: Finds the Z (or associated value) for a given Y, using floor or ceiling entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specific value for a given Y, replacing existing data.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the existing data for a specific Y, updating the stored aggregation.

methods.name: getHolder
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ValuesHolder for a specific Y value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the stored value for a specific Y.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation summarizing the data set.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Exports data points to a Writer in CSV format.
